name: The Ultimate Net Worth & FIRE Master Vault (2026 Edition)
tagline: The all-in-one private wealth dashboard, Federal Reserve percentile benchmark, and retirement freedom calculator for Google Sheets & Excel.

features.title: Executive KPI Dashboard
features.desc: Automated cards for Total Net Worth, Liquid Net Worth, Month-over-Month change, and trailing 12-month in-cell SPARKLINE trajectory charts.

features.title: Federal Reserve SCF Percentile Engine
features.desc: Select your age group and instantly see your exact percentile ranking against official US central bank data right inside your spreadsheet.

features.title: FIRE Freedom & Early Retirement Countdown
features.desc: Calculates your Lean FIRE, Standard FIRE (4% Rule), Fat FIRE, and Coast FIRE numbers with an automated retirement date countdown.

features.title: 12-Month Historical Wealth Ledger
features.desc: Structured asset & liability tracking for cash, 401(k), Roth IRA, brokerage, real estate equity, mortgages, and debt.

features.title: Cash Drag & Asset Allocation Optimizer
features.desc: Automatically alerts you if excessive cash is losing purchasing power to inflation and balances your stock vs. bond vs. cash ratio.

features.title: Debt Avalanche & Snowball Calculator
features.desc: Ranks up to 8 debts by interest rate or balance with custom payoff milestone projections.

features.title: 100% Offline & Private
features.desc: Never link bank passwords or share credentials with third-party apps. Runs 100% locally on your personal device.
